CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_global_master_gtin_page(p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 1000)
 RETURNS TABLE(item_code text, gtin text, item_name text, category text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;
    return query
    select g.item_code,g.gtin,g.item_name,g.category
    from public.pharmflow_global_gtin_v1 g
    order by g.id
    offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0)
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,1000),1),2000);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_pharmacy_admin(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select public.is_system_owner() or exists (
        select 1
        from public.pharmacy_members m
        join public.pharmacies p on p.id = m.pharmacy_id
        where m.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
          and m.user_id = auth.uid()
          and m.role = 'admin'
          and m.active = true
          and p.status = 'active'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_pharmacy_member(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select public.is_system_owner() or exists (
        select 1
        from public.pharmacy_members m
        join public.pharmacies p on p.id = m.pharmacy_id
        where m.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
          and m.user_id = auth.uid()
          and m.active = true
          and p.status = 'active'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_system_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1 from public.system_owners o
        where o.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.medryvo_is_system_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    select exists(
        select 1
        from public.system_owners so
        where so.user_id = auth.uid()
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_can_access_pharmacy(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select auth.uid() is not null and (
        public.is_system_owner()
        or exists(select 1 from public.pharmacy_members m where m.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and coalesce(m.active,true)=true)
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_is_member(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.system_owners so where so.user_id=auth.uid())
 or exists(select 1 from public.pharmacy_members pm where pm.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id and pm.user_id=auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_manifest_member_v2(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    select
        auth.uid() is not null
        and (
            exists(
                select 1
                from public.system_owners so
                where so.user_id=auth.uid()
            )
            or exists(
                select 1
                from public.pharmacy_members pm
                where pm.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id
                  and pm.user_id=auth.uid()
            )
        );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pharmflow_receiving_member_v2(p_pharmacy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    select auth.uid() is not null and (
        exists(select 1 from public.system_owners so where so.user_id=auth.uid())
        or exists(
            select 1 from public.pharmacy_members pm
            where pm.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id and pm.user_id=auth.uid()
        )
    );
$function$
